headline: A 2013 law renames the tax code section on spousal IRAs after former Senator Kay Bailey Hutchison.
what_it_does: This law changes the name of the section heading in the Internal Revenue Code that covers individual retirement accounts for married people. The new name is the Kay Bailey Hutchison Spousal IRA. It is a name change only and does not change how the accounts work, what they cost, or who can use them.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 25, 2013.
